description: Building America Solution Center - Disaster Resistance Tool is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOE Building Technology Office; Pacific Northwest National Laboratory. Builders, remodelers, restoration contractors, and home occupants can find guidance to make homes more resistant to natural disasters: this site provides construction guidance for energy efficient and disaster resistant residential buildings. The tool provides best practices for construction and renovating homes to be resilient and energy efficient. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Cold, Flooding – General, High Winds, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
